title: Kissed Velvety Middle Eastern Chickpeas Falafel
description: A low-glycemic, meal-prep friendly Middle Eastern dish featuring black cardamom pods and air-fried falafel, with a grassy and velvety texture.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a food processor, combine chickpeas, ground black cardamom pods, onion, garlic, parsley, lemon juice, salt, and pepper, and process until well combined and slightly chunky.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into 8-10 falafel patties.
Place the falafel patties in a single layer in the air fryer basket.
Drizzle the olive oil over the falafel patties.
Air-fry the falafel for 12-15 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through.
Remove the falafel from the air fryer and let them cool on a paper towel-lined plate.
Serve the falafel warm or at room temperature.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
